Wichita Falls, Texas · eat

Restaurants in Wichita Falls for cyclists

Where to eat in Wichita Falls the night before a ride and the afternoon after. Nothing fancy. Real food, real portions, places that are open when you need them.

For: Hotter'N Hell Hundred.

Restaurants in Wichita Falls for cyclists, listed

  1. Branding Iron

    Texas barbecue · 104 E Scott Ave, Wichita Falls, TX 76301

    Home-style barbecue plates a block from the HHH start line; the site has fed people since 1939

  2. 8th Street Coffee House

    Coffee, breakfast, sandwiches · 901 8th St, Wichita Falls, TX 76301

    Downtown breakfast and coffee stop, open 7:30 am weekdays; closes at 2 pm

  3. Half Pint Taproom & Restoration Hall

    Craft beer, brick-oven pizza · 817 Ohio Ave, Wichita Falls, TX 76301

    Downtown taproom with pizza and a live-music hall; evenings only, closed Sunday

  4. Wellborn 2R Steakhouse

    Steakhouse · 306 Travis St, Wichita Falls, TX 76301

    Inside the Delta hotel at the MPEC; serves dinner nightly and a weekend brunch from 6:30 am, handy on ride morning

  5. McBride's Steakhouse

    Mesquite-grilled steaks · 4537 Maplewood Ave, Wichita Falls, TX 76308

    Family-run since 1992, south side near the Kemp Boulevard hotels

  6. Pelican's

    Steak and seafood · 2301 Midwestern Pkwy, Wichita Falls, TX 76308

    Independent, family-owned for more than 20 years; the sit-down dinner spot on the south side
